title: 11章、来自食材的反杀
lines: 这个时候，张荼才注意到了自己身旁委屈吧唧的子矜，但是老油子张荼转瞬便是明白了前因后果。在秦风嘲讽的笑声中，将手机缓缓地递到了子矜的面前。
“喏，给你看。我告诉边关月陆望舒还活着。但是我们所有人都猜错了他的反应。”
一开始子矜还是爱答不理的模样，可是听完后面的话语，却是忍不住惊呼起来。她万万没想到，张荼口中所说的边关月，竟然真的是上个纪元的边关月。
“你得琅缳秘录便是出自他手，是他从他所知道的诸多法典秘籍之中为你精挑细选出来的。他的情况有些特殊，到现在我也不清楚他究竟是怎么存活下来的。”说到这里张荼似是想起了什么，接着闷闷地说道：“若是论存在的时间长短，边关月应该还排不上号，至少我知道的，有一批人甚至是从前几纪元便是已经存在了。”
“这片天地，到底有几个纪元？”秦风也开始好奇了。
张荼揉揉眉心，说道：“算上我们的纪元，有记录的一共是九个纪元，就是按照顺序排列的，当然每个纪元还有别的称呼，但是我忘了，你们要是有兴趣，等到日后去琅琊城中，你们自己问边关月好了。真的可以多跟他交流一下，那可真是个大宝贝。”
听到张荼敷衍的解释，子矜轻轻皱了皱琼鼻，一双明眸流转着慧黠的光芒，道：“这些东西就不能你告诉我么？不过为什么他的选择和陆望舒的猜测是截然不同的？”
“因为他的实力，你们或许不清楚，但是我很明白，因为某种原因，他的实力会随着我的实力进步而进步。新时代的躺平型选手，所以他现在的实力应该与我一般，不过是五品蕴灵境界而已，也就是如今所说的S级选手。”
张荼摩挲着下巴说道：“而且从五品开始，有了更为详细的划分，如今我的实力应该是在SS级别，也就是五品中期。当然境界这个东西比较虚无缥缈，更多的还是要看实际的战力，对于边关月而说，这种活得我们连零头都比不上的，自然是可以轻松吊打我的。当然了，也仅仅是吊打我，拯救陆望舒却是差了许多，毕竟一品巅峰的陆望舒都被困在了光门之中，五品的边关月是去送菜么？”
“我可不相信曾经的巅峰强者会没有一点办法……”子矜小声地嘟囔着，道：“那边关月不就是一个实体化的系统么？所以系统送了一座城？”
对于子矜的话语，张荼又何尝不知道，毕竟作为一个时代最强序列之一，肯定有着不为人知的秘术。但显然，对于拯救陆望舒而言，理智上来讲，也不差这两年了。同样的，边关月的话语，却是对张荼承载了太多的期望。
一行三人带着巨大的斗笠，以及不知道张荼从哪里捯饬出来的老款墨镜，再配合上一身偏古的装扮，不说有多别扭了。但是如此一来，却是让三人顺顺利利地进入了这座城池。看着城门之上的牌匾。
content_zh:
跃起的庞然大物，头大身子小，好似一个巨大版的蝌蚪，又像是一个缩小版的畸形鲸鱼，要不是前面那一对标志性的肉须，张荼一时间还真不知道这是一个什么东西。

    云苍声音颤抖着说道：“哥……这是鲸鱼么？”

    张荼喉咙滑动了一下，但是口中仍是强装淡定地说道：“哪里是鲸鱼，这是河，不是海，还有，这个东西你可没少吃啊……铁锅鲶鱼……啧～”

    “嗯？”

    “有什么问题么？”

    张荼看似与云苍闲聊，可是一双眸子却是死死盯着在二人周遭不断游弋的巨大化后的鲶鱼，不过看其这模样，想必，在天地异化之前，便已经是一个庞然大物了。

    真不知道它究竟是如何躲避过夷水两畔的捕鱼人。

    不过话说回来，鲶鱼极其肥嫩的，将鲶鱼背部切开，用独头蒜，再加一些葱丝和姜片略腌。

    而后，抓起一些花椒和大料，在锅里加了豆油，先把鱼油和大蒜放里面炸出香味，在加入酱汁，葱丝姜片，花椒大料，以及大酱和辣椒，添热水做汤，待烧开后放入鲶鱼。

    大蒜放得很多，闻起来奇香扑鼻。等到将鱼肉盛到碗里，汤汁已经相当浓郁，将干硬的野菜团子泡到汤汁里等待热透，而后先吃鱼肉。

    鱼肉香得几乎就像是一兜油，却丝毫不腻，带着大蒜浓郁到可以抗拒任何腥气的香味，越过唇舌，经过牙齿，滑入喉咙，那满足感完全不是香粥所能比拟的。

    可是……眼前的这鲶鱼，怕是做着与自己一般无二的打算，当然没有这么多的步骤，而是一口吞嘎嘣脆。

    张荼明白，眼前的鲶鱼，怕是已经不再是寻常的鱼兽，而是在天地异变间得到了较大的好处，甚至隐隐开启了灵智，不过是此时仍旧是浑浑噩噩，更多的是靠着本能行事，但是已经懂得趋利避害。

    不过……

    张荼摩挲着下巴，如此想来，这鲶鱼怕是把自己当做了罕见的天材地宝，行走的稀世灵药？吞了自己会对它有相当大的好处，但是不断的游弋，怕是也对自己的实力有所忌惮？

    随即，目中便是露出了兴奋的色彩。

    原来，我这么强的么？

    不过就在这时，那鲶鱼终是按捺不住本能的渴望，变强，是霜天万物的本能，烙印在灵魂之中的本能。

    就在人鱼对峙之时，夷水对面的岸边，出现一道俊逸的身影，不过手中的古朴长枪，却是不禁恍然，这究竟是异变，还是集体的穿越？

    张荼看着迎面而来的鲶鱼，鲶鱼口中的腥气扑面而来，顿时让二人面色铁青，但尽管如此，张荼已经是大略计算一下，将云苍远远的抛掷出去。

    随即，自己一个闪身躲避开了这一记猛扑。

    云苍的身形在空中飘飘荡荡，还有余力看着周围的风景在眼前飞快地飞掠，蓦然，腰间一紧，自己便是来到了一个宽阔的胸怀之中。

    没有预料之中的疼痛，反而是感受到了腰部手臂中所蕴含的爆炸性的力量。

    云苍感受到脚底的踏实感，这才想起抬头看是谁将自己接住，抬起头来才发现是一个古风的俊逸男子。

    落地之后，边关月便是快速地放开云苍，似是在躲避着什么一般，双目凝神看着不断腾挪的张荼，心中的想法不断幻灭着。

    云苍见眼前男子没有沟通的欲望，但是所释放的善意也足够他乖乖巧巧的站立在一旁。

    而张荼将云苍投掷出去之后，便没有再去想，不就是呛水么？死不了就行，这里既然有着这个大大大鲶鱼，应该没有其他的攻击性生物了。
content_en:
The leaping behemoth had a big head and a small body. It looked like a giant tadpole or a smaller version of a deformed whale. If it weren't for the pair of iconic tentacles in front, Zhang Tu wouldn't have known what it was.

Yun Cang said with a trembling voice: "Brother...is this a whale?"

Zhang Tu's throat slid slightly, but he still pretended to be calm and said: "Where is the whale? This is a river, not a sea. Also, you have eaten a lot of this... iron pot catfish... tsk~"

"Huh?"

"Is there any problem?"

Zhang Tu seemed to be chatting with Yun Cang, but his eyes were fixed on the giant catfish swimming around the two of them. However, looking at its appearance, it must have been a giant before the alienation of heaven and earth.

I really don’t know how it avoided the fishermen on both sides of the Yi River.

But having said that, the catfish is extremely fat and tender. Cut the back of the catfish and marinate it slightly with a clove of garlic, some shredded green onions and ginger slices.

Then, grab some Sichuan peppercorns and aniseed, add soybean oil to the pot, first fry the fish oil and garlic to make it fragrant, then add the sauce, shredded green onions and ginger, Sichuan peppercorns, bean paste and chili, add hot water to make soup, and add the catfish after it boils.

There is a lot of garlic and it smells amazing.When the fish is put into the bowl, the soup is already quite rich. Soak the dry and hard wild vegetable dumplings in the soup and wait for them to heat through, then eat the fish first.

The fish meat is almost as fragrant as a pocket of oil, but not greasy at all. The aroma of garlic is so strong that it can resist any fishy smell. It passes over the lips and tongue, passes through the teeth, and slides into the throat. The satisfaction is completely unmatched by fragrant porridge.

But... the catfish in front of me is probably making the same plan as me. Of course, it doesn't have so many steps, but it just eats it in one bite.

Zhang Tu understood that the catfish in front of him was probably no longer an ordinary fish beast, but had benefited greatly from the changes in the world, and had even vaguely opened up his spiritual intelligence. However, at this time, he was still confused and acted more on instinct, but he had learned to seek advantages and avoid disadvantages.

But...

Zhang Tu rubbed his chin, thinking about it this way, this catfish might think of himself as a rare treasure of heaven and earth, a rare walking elixir?Swallowing oneself would be of great benefit to it, but if it kept wandering around, might it also be wary of its own strength?

Immediately, excitement appeared in his eyes.

So, am I so strong?

But at this moment, the catfish couldn't restrain his instinctive desire. To become stronger was the instinct of all creatures in the frost sky, an instinct imprinted in the soul.

Just as the mermaids were confronting each other, a handsome figure appeared on the shore opposite Yishui. However, with the ancient spear in his hand, he couldn't help but wonder, is this a mutation or a collective time travel?

Zhang Tu looked at the oncoming catfish, and the fishy smell from the catfish's mouth hit his face, making the two of them look pale. However, despite this, Zhang Tu had already made a rough calculation and threw Yun Cang far away.

Immediately, he dodged the punch and dodged it.

Yun Cang's figure was floating in the air, and he still had the energy to watch the surrounding scenery fly by quickly in front of his eyes. Suddenly, his waist tightened, and he came into a broad mind.

Instead of the expected pain, I felt the explosive power contained in my waist and arms.

Yun Cang felt the solid feeling on the soles of his feet, and then he remembered to look up to see who was catching him. When he looked up, he found that it was a handsome man with an ancient style.

After landing, Bian Guanyue quickly let go of Yun Cang, as if she was avoiding something. She stared at Zhang Tu who was constantly moving around, and the thoughts in her heart continued to disillusion.

Yun Cang saw that the man in front of him had no desire to communicate, but the kindness he showed was enough for him to stand aside obediently.

After Zhang Tu threw Yun Cang out, he didn't think about it anymore. Wasn't he just choking on the water?As long as it doesn't die, since there is this big catfish here, there should be no other aggressive creatures.
